clips.title: The story
paras: Earth Sapta is a replenishment ritual offered by Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache. Young shaman undertaking their initiation to commune with the spirits of the stone require this draught to open their inner sight. Should a novice lose or spill their prepared brew before finishing their rite, the seer prepares another to ensure their trial may continue.

The path of the shaman begins with attuning the mortal senses to forces beyond physical sight. To perceive the elemental spirits of the land, an initiate must ingest a potent ritual brew known as a sapta. Infused with natural essences bound to the element of stone and soil, the Earth Sapta lifts the veil between the physical realm and the spiritual plane, allowing a novice to commune directly with the earth elementals of Mulgore.

The spiritual arts demand discipline, but seasoned seers recognize that young initiates often falter or misplace sacred reagents while braving the wilds. Seer Ravenfeather keeps a steady vigil at Camp Narache, ensuring that any pupil who loses their brew before their communion at the stone monument can renew their preparation. With quiet patience, she provides another vessel so the novice may face the spirits unbroken.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Take this and remember, it is sacred.
